name: Average ERPs
summary: Brainlife.io app: average MEG/EEG epochs into one or more condition ERPs (Evoked)

parameters.description: Do you want all of your epoch types/stimuli/conditions to be averaged together? If not, enter the names of the epoch types/stimuli/conditions in the string below.

Stimulus/condition names to average. To produce SEVERAL Evokeds in one run, separate independent groups with ";"; within a group, conditions are still pooled together with "," (e.g. "face/famous,face/unfamiliar;scrambled/famous,scrambled/unfamiliar" produces two Evokeds). A value with no ";" is a single group -- one Evoked, same as before.

Name(s) for each group in stimulus_names, matching 1:1 and ";"-separated the same way (e.g. "face;scrambled" for the example above). Used as each output Evoked's label. Just enter the name(s) with no quotation marks.
Add a list (comma-separated) of time values at which you would like to display topomaps on a joint ERP plot.
